summary: Iteration 13: validated (1) /vigilance phenomenon filter (9 filter buttons all functional, panel toggles 'Niveau général' ↔ 'Niveau · Orages/Vent/Canicule', GeoJSON re-renders on filter change with key fr-{ts}-{filter}, restoring 'Tous' returns to original yellow count of 33), (2) Dashboard timeline scrub anchoring trajectory on at_ts (live mode emits no at_ts → after scrubbing slider to mid-range, /api/storms/trajectory calls include at_ts=<epoch>, badge label switches from 'TRAJECTOIRE' to 'TRAJ · REJEU', icon swaps Activity → Clock, returning slider to NOW restores live), (3) backend at_ts param wired correctly on /api/storms/trajectory, /api/storms/approach (accepts float, rejects non-numeric with 422, JSON shape unchanged), (4) lightning.store.recent until_ts filter works at unit level (verified with 4 strikes at -3600/-1800/-600/-60s — until_ts=base-1000 returns only the 2 oldest, both since_ts+until_ts combined returns the 2 middle ones), (5) /api/weather/vigilance/full payload exposes all 8 expected phenomena keys (orage,vent,pluie,canicule,grand-froid,neige,brouillard,avalanche) each with {key,level,level_fr,color}. 14/14 backend pytest pass + frontend e2e pass. Live regression intact (initial trajectory calls have NO at_ts).
critical_code_review_comments: lightning.py StrikeStore.recent: until_ts uses strict '>' (s.ts > until_ts → skip), so timestamps exactly == until_ts are KEPT. Consistent with FastAPI route docstring claiming inclusive lower / exclusive upper, but actual implementation is inclusive on BOTH bounds — minor docstring drift, not a bug.
VigilancePage.jsx:81 levelBy useMemo has eslint-disable for exhaustive-deps because getDisplayLevel closure depends on filter — works but could be cleaner by inlining the logic in the memo itself.

TrajectoryBadge.jsx: when detected=false, the violet/red accent only shows on the swap of Activity↔Clock icon (icon class is text-slate-400 for undetected, so accent color isn't visible). Label 'TRAJECTOIRE' vs 'TRAJ · REJEU' makes the mode obvious. Tested OK.

/api/storms/trajectory returns 200 + {detected:false, reason:'not_enough_strikes'} with NO strikes in DB at test time — visual trajectory line cannot be validated, but the at_ts contract (URL param, JSON shape) is fully verified via network logs.
MapPanel.jsx (per spec) wires cursorTs+isLive on TrajectoryLayer + TrajectoryBadge — visually confirmed by badge re-render on slider scrub.
